series_short_description: From childhood cartoon passwords and square-closet sanctuaries in Virginia Beach to Coastal Virginia Transit buses, walking out of Roosevelt Rehabilitation Center after twelve days, and serving in the Virginia General Assembly and the United States Senate, autistic fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel ("Nate") Prairie never leave each other behind.
series_description: Katie & Nathaniel follows the thirty-three-year journey of autistic fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel ("Nate") Prairie (born April 8, 1985) across Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Richmond, and Washington, D.C. From secret afternoon cartoon passwords, summer camp at Virginia Dominion University alongside Michael and Rachel Ragsdale, the Blizzard of '96, and getting their first compact powerchairs at sixteen, to reclaiming their West Ocean View sanctuary, walking out of the Roosevelt Rehabilitation Center in Fishersville after twelve days, launching the Ideas for CVTA transit blog, and rising from Kempsville City Council to the Virginia House of Delegates, the Senate of Virginia, and the United States Senate, Nate and Katie prove that twin brothers and sisters are each other's lifelong safe person.
